string.text: Artifact Visibility by Expand. Idea: SoC-style Artefacts (DLTX) by MaxSpringer.
All settings take effect after you load a save (or start a new game).
Off = all artefacts look and behave as without this mod (hidden until a detector finds them, original light and particles). Takes effect after loading a save.

Artefacts stay visible to the eye, but a detector only beeps for and shows the artefacts of its tier, as in normal GAMMA (simple detectors miss rare artefacts). Off = every detector finds every artefact. Costs a tiny check per artefact every 2 seconds. Takes effect after loading a save.
Coloured light that artefacts lying in the world cast around them. Off = no light (slightly cheaper for the GPU near anomaly fields). Takes effect after loading a save.

Particle effects around artefacts lying in the world (glowing halo, sparks, smoke). Many artefacts still look like they glow with the light switched off because of these. Off = only the artefact model. Takes effect after loading a save.
Writes one line with the number of changed artefact values to the game log (xray_*.log, tag [SoCArts]) on every load. Only for bug reports.
